scripts.lint: bun run lint:plugin && oxlint --deny-warnings apps/web/src apps/web/test apps/web/workbench apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/floor/src apps/floor/test packages scripts stacks testing/flows testing/look alchemy.run.ts && bun scripts/lint/styles.ts && bun scripts/lint/suppressions.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contract/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/world/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/atlas/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chains/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/wallets/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/floor/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p testing/look/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p testing/flows/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: bun scripts/lint/styles.ts && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && bun scripts/bundle-budget/cli.ts --profile complete
scripts.build:floor: CI=true ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bun test --preload ./apps/floor/test/local-only.ts ./apps/floor/test/build.test.ts && bun scripts/bundle-budget/modules.ts --target floor --directory .alchemy/bundles/FloorWorker --entry worker.js
scripts.build:chains: bun build ./packages/chains/src/solana/index.ts ./packages/chains/src/evm/index.ts --root ./packages/chains/src --target browser --sourcemap=external --outdir ./work/chains-bundle && bun scripts/bundle-budget/modules.ts --target floor --directory work/chains-bundle --entry solana/index.js --entry evm/index.js
scripts.build: bun run vendor:verify && bun run build:web && bun run build:floor && bun run build:chains
scripts.test:flow: playwright test --config testing/flows/playwright.config.ts && bun run test:renderer
scripts.test: bun run test:leaf && bun run test:native && bun run test:flow
scripts.build:workbench: bun scripts/lint/styles.ts && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode workbench
scripts.test:phone:mac: FLOOR_PHONE_RENDERER=apple bun run test:renderer --grep "configured phone profile"
